title: Create a current CommandCenter deployment-source manifest and provenance check
description: Turn TASK-234 parity evidence into a durable, read-only deployment-source manifest and repeatable runtime-provenance check. Preserve historical records as provenance, but make the current configured launcher, installed-copy drift, and listener-identity uncertainty discoverable before any future UI task. Do not edit CommandCenterUI, run the installer, restart services, alter policy/authority, or change TASK-227.
acceptance_criteria: The manifest records the current configured desktop and launcher chain, candidate-path accessibility, template-versus-installed fingerprints, and the explicit distinction between a configured target and a running listener.

The manifest specifies a read-only repeat check with expected outcomes for free port, occupied port with verified server provenance, and occupied port with unverified provenance; it does not start, stop, or modify a process.

The manifest gives a bounded decision gate for template deployment versus an external installed-copy change, retaining explicit operator approval for any external edit and no implementation selection by inference.
The work makes no UI, deployment, installer, policy, authority, shared-state, or TASK-227 change and is independently reviewable as a durable input to a future implementation task.
